title: On a phone the table scrolls sideways with Subtotal pinned, the totals bar sits outside the scroll area, and the chevrons work on touch
refs: specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 17 S17-R4; S17-R5; Story 10 S10-R5 (mobile)
custom_preconds: 1. The report is open on a phone-sized viewport (under 1024px) with at least one rep row.
custom_steps:
1. Swipe the data table sideways and watch the Subtotal column.
2. Look below the table for the totals bar and swipe the table again.
3. Tap a rep row's chevron.
custom_expected:
1. The table scrolls horizontally to expose all columns; the pinned Subtotal column stays visible at the right edge throughout.
2. The mobile external totals bar ("Totals" left, grand Subtotal right) sits below the table, OUTSIDE the horizontal scroll container — it does not scroll horizontally and is always fully visible.
3. The chevron expands/collapses the rep on touch.
